interface.longDescription: Codex-installed Tuolin business agent marketplace. Includes the local knowledge-base Agent, controlled LinkedIn workflows, a planning-only video Agent for YouTube Shorts and TikTok, and the existing full YouTube Shorts creation workflow. The planning Agent has its own knowledge interface, performs no public trend search, produces a 9:16 shot plan with timed narration, and automatically derives SRT after confirmation. The full creation Agent remains available for trend research, Dreamina handoff, download, and assembly.
